purpose: Classify the exact hosted-network failure stage blocking the already-authorized production SSH host-key observation, without opening an SSH session and without mutating production.
acceptance: The implementation PR changes only the diagnostic workflow and this scope file.
The diagnostic is triggered only by the repository owner using the exact authority command.
The diagnostic performs DNS resolution and repeated ssh-keyscan observation from the hosted runner only; it does not open an SSH session.
The protected SSH port and fingerprint are consumed only as protected inputs and are never published.
No private key, SSH username, password, production environment value, raw host key or raw diagnostic log is published.
No database, migration, credential, session, MFA, role, DNS, Caddy, SSH-pin, container, image or production runtime mutation occurs.
The diagnostic emits only a coarse failure class and PRODUCTION_MUTATION=NONE; new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
